entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Do you?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He adjusted the folds of his robe."
entries.dialogueText: He adjusted the folds of his robe.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I will remind you that you had an..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will remind you that you had an opportunity to strengthen those ties by lifting your Golcondist ban. You did not seize it."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""But there is one other thing Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "But there is one other thing Rizia can help us with. Energy."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I hear you are constructing a pipe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hear you are constructing a pipeline between Rizia and Morella. Can it be extended to my country?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I doubt that Morella would allow s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I doubt that Morella would allow such an extension given your history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Agreed. We shouldn't be getting to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. We shouldn't be getting too far ahead of ourselves."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It is not Derdia's fault that we a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not Derdia's fault that we are cruelly barred from our ancestral places of worship."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perfect. Derdia, Rizia and Morella..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perfect. Derdia, Rizia and Morella will stand strong against the CSP's overreach."

entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You do not want to extend your pip..."
entries.dialogueText: "You do not want to extend your pipeline from Morella. But perhaps you would still be willing to ship us oil or gas across the Gulf of Moridia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It depends on whether you are able..."
entries.dialogueText: "It depends on whether you are able to make peace with the Morellan prime minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An interesting possibility. I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "An interesting possibility. I will consider it."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I recognize that it would require..."
entries.dialogueText: "I recognize that it would require us to cooperate with Morella."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""But for a chance at energy securit..."
entries.dialogueText: "But for a chance at energy security, I am willing to face the devil herself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We would be, if we had any energy..."
entries.dialogueText: "We would be, if we had any energy to sell you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am afraid not. We barely have en..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am afraid not. We barely have enough energy to meet Morella's needs, let alone Derdia's."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Until your holy institutions respe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Until your holy institutions respect my country's religion, a strictly transactional relationship is all I will agree to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I shall begin the pipeline. But yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shall begin the pipeline. But you must be ready to stop your disgraceful border violations."
entries.menuText: "I shall begin the pipeline. But you must be ready to stop your disgraceful border violations." [-2 Energy For +2 Budget Per Turn, -2 Budget Per Turn For Pipeline]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Excellent. We will build the pipel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent. We will build the pipeline, and together, our three nations will begin a new era of peace and cooperation."
entries.menuText: "Excellent. We will build the pipeline, and together, our three nations will begin a new era of peace and cooperation." [-2 Energy For +2 Budget Per Turn, -2 Budget Per Turn For Pipeline]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With all apologies, I cannot. A pi..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all apologies, I cannot. A pipeline to Morella is all I can manage right now."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Peace? Her country discarded that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Peace? Her country discarded that chance when it closed its borders to us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal smiled faintly."
entries.dialogueText: Sal smiled faintly.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Ignoring your religious ideals for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ignoring your religious ideals for the sake of earthly riches. Your true colors are showing, Supreme Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""More proof that Golcondists don't..."
entries.dialogueText: "More proof that Golcondists don't have ideals at all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Remember Wruhec's words, Sal. Do n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember Wruhec's words, Sal. Do not reach for the stars above your head before tending to the soil beneath your feet,"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Precisely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely."

entries.dialogueText: "Then we have failed to find common ground once more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. An energy agreement it..."

entries.dialogueText: "I do not share your animosity towards the superpowers. For the last 40 years, they have been kind enough to leave Derdia alone."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Indeed not.""

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""'United' is not the term for it.""

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Wehlen? Your Majesty, Wiktor Smola..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen? Your Majesty, Wiktor Smolak's persecution of Golcondists makes your blasphemy laws look gentle."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's exactly the kind of partner..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's exactly the kind of partnership I was thinking of, Supreme Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Ah. So the mighty Rizia is facing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah. So the mighty Rizia is facing an energy shortage."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""But as I understand it, your own s..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as I understand it, your own supplies are running too low to provide us with what we need."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Empire of Moridia, united once..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Empire of Moridia, united once more. It warms my heart."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Yes, we cannot be expected to carr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we cannot be expected to carry out our religious duties without heat or electricity."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""All the more reason for our nation..."
entries.dialogueText: "All the more reason for our nations to stay at a distance from each other."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""He will not even grant our pilgrim..."
entries.dialogueText: "He will not even grant our pilgrims passage through his country to the holy Archsanctuary of Deyr. And you think he will trade with us?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Think about it. Once your Zille ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about it. Once your Zille harbor is recovered, the distance between our ports will be practically nothing."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It will be easier to trade with Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will be easier to trade with Rizia once your Zille harbor is recovered from that madman."
